films.title: The Ultimate Gift
films.overview: When his wealthy grandfather finally dies, Jason Stevens fully expects to benefit when it comes to the reading of the will. But instead of a sizable inheritance, Jason receives a test, a series of tasks he must complete before he can get any money.

films.title: One Night with the King
films.overview: In Biblical times, a girl disguises her Jewish origins when the Persian king comes looking for a new bride among his subjects.
